integrity: The theorem is proved by a Markov reduction, a transitivity/aperiodicity argument, disjoint orbit enumeration and an asymptotic tail estimate. Finite exhaustive graph computations support but do not replace the proof. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only odd numbers of equal interval cells; the piecewise-linear slope-two tent map; topological mixing, not conditional transfer-spectrum statistics. A priori historical-priority risk remains for equivalent counts in general transitive-permutation enumeration.
title: Exact mixing-permutation counts and a three-term rarity law for odd-grid shuffled tent maps
